jess: Quick check: want to add a protocol toggle in the console so teams can pick rest | grpc | dual for a route, with a canary slider. Thoughts on telemetry/quota UX?

omar: Per-route is powerful but risky. Recommend tenant-default + opt-in per-route to reduce blast radius.

liam: Router can do per-route flags. Main runtime risks: transcoding CPU and cache invalidation when path mappings change. We should simulate the cache impact before widescale.

sasha: Tracing concern: transcode creates detached spans unless we propagate a delegation id. Sampling will skew metrics if transcode is rare.

kate: Console needs to show protocol split over time, avg latency delta, and annotated traces where transcode happened. Ops will want that.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: protocol-toggle canary for service `generator-service` -> 10% grpc at 2026-03-05T10:00Z.

omar: Need strict transcode rules: no bidi streams, avoid Any/polymorphic, require 1:1 method mapping. Otherwise semantics differ.

jess: Proposal: proto = source-of-truth. Mark routes `transcode_allowed`. Browser routes default to rest; add header `x-redwood-proto: v1` for explicit proto.

liam: Config keys: protocol_mode: rest|grpc|dualstack, canary_percent, transcode_allowed. Router will tag spans with protocol.choice. Batching rules differ.

sasha: Telemetry: add protocol.choice and transcode=true|false. Record ingress/egress bytes. Keep higher sampling for transcode traces for first 14 days of rollout.

kate: Quota: charge backend post-transcode but map charges back to originating route for visibility. Console shows both.

omar: Edge case: grpc-web in browsers is flaky. Console should warn and suggest our polyfill or fallback to rest.

jess: UX: toggle + canary slider + preflight compatibility test that lists field remaps/losses and warns if fields dropped.

liam: Preflight must run against the pinned backend version. Add smoke tests in canary flow.

sasha: Action items: header conventions (x-redwood-proto, x-redwood-transcode), telemetry fields and dashboards, quota-mapping doc.

jess: I'll draft an RFC and console mockups tonight. Prototype this sprint? :thumbsup: :thumbsdown

kate: +1 :thumbsup:

omar: +1

liam: +1, schedule 20m demo with infra next week.

sasha: +1 and add rollback runbook for data-loss scenarios.

deploy-bot: Canary created at 2026-03-05T09:55Z for `generator-service` route (10% -> grpc). Monitor latency, error-rate, and trace-diff ratio.
